description: Type createServer's Primary IP quota failure. A Server takes a Primary IPv4 (and IPv6) on create, so an exhausted project quota fails the create with Forbidden (403 resource_limit_exceeded, message 'Primary IP limit exceeded'), the same error createPrimaryIp already types as PrimaryIpLimitExceeded.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The project has no remaining Primary IP quota for the Server's public IPs (Hetzner `resource_limit_exceeded`, HTTP 403). Servers and Load Balancers share it; it frees up as they are deleted.
